# anecdotes_analysis_rules (Data Source)

Lists Anecdotes Analysis Rules, with optional filtering by evidence, origin, state or type.

The account's own rules and the rules shipped with the platform are returned together;
filter on `rule_origin` to separate them. Deleted rules are archived rather than
removed, and are excluded unless `include_archived` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_evidences" "policies" {
  name_contains = "All policies"
}

# Every rule attached to one evidence, the account's own and the platform's.
data "anecdotes_analysis_rules" "for_evidence" {
  evidence_id = data.anecdotes_evidences.policies.evidences[0].evidence_id
}

# Only the rules the account authored. These are the ones
# anecdotes_analysis_rule can manage.
data "anecdotes_analysis_rules" "custom" {
  rule_origin = "custom"
}

# Library rules that are currently switched off.
data "anecdotes_analysis_rules" "disabled_library_rules" {
  rule_origin = "library"
  rule_state  = "inactive"
}

output "disabled_library_rule_names" {
  value = [for r in data.anecdotes_analysis_rules.disabled_library_rules.rules : r.rule_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `evidence_id` (String) Only return rules attached to this evidence.
- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include deleted (archived) rules. Defaults to false.
- `rule_origin` (String) Only return rules with this origin: "library" or "custom".
- `rule_state` (String) Only return rules in this state: "active" or "inactive".
- `rule_type` (String) Only return rules of this type: "uam" or "eid".

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) The analysis rules matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `total_count` (Number) The number of rules returned.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `account_scoping_list` (Set of String) Service instance IDs the rule is scoped to. Unordered.
- `account_scoping_type` (String) Which accounts the rule applies to.
- `alert_level` (Number) Severity: 30 (warning) or 50 (gap). 3, 5 and 10 describe an evaluation outcome rather than a configured severity.
- `evidence_id` (String) The evidence this rule evaluates.
- `last_updated` (String) When the rule was last modified.
- `last_updated_by` (String) Who last modified the rule.
- `library_rule_id` (String) The library rule this rule was derived from.
- `rule_id` (String) The unique identifier of the analysis rule.
- `rule_is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the rule has been deleted. Deleting archives a rule rather than removing it.
- `rule_message` (String) The message shown for rows the rule matches.
- `rule_name` (String) The rule's display name.
- `rule_origin` (String) Whether the rule ships with the platform ("library") or is authored by the account ("custom").
- `rule_query_message` (String) Message associated with the stored query.
- `rule_query_str` (String) The query as the platform stored it, serialized as a JSON string.
- `rule_query_type` (String) The query language: "aql", "aqlext" or "pandas".
- `rule_state` (String) Whether the rule is evaluated: "active" or "inactive".
- `rule_type` (String) Processing type: "uam" or "eid".
